evidence: Lucr. 5.902: corpora leōnum; Hor. Epod. 6.5: canis (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: deep yellow, reddish yellow, tawny, mostly poetic: lions, wolves, sand, gold. Traupman also gives it for tan, sandy hair and strawberry blond.
Classically “of a deer” (pellis, Hor. Ep. 1.2.66); Lewis & Short cites it as a colour only of a horse, in Palladius (Mart. 13.4).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
